note: FNS 722.6 is a QC variance-exclusion rule, not caseworker policy. It instructs QC reviewers on when to exclude variances from error calculations when a household's certification period was shortened via a Notice of Expiration (because the state couldn't obtain sufficient information to act on a change). The three conditions listed (sample month is next-to-last or last month, household did not refuse to cooperate, change was reported timely) are all QC review criteria for determining whether to count a variance as an error. The OLG has no equivalent because this is audit methodology — it governs how QC reviewers assess state agency actions, not how caseworkers process cases. The underlying state action (closing a case when verification isn't received) is covered in the OLG under general case maintenance and unclear information procedures, but the specific variance-exclusion logic of 722.6 has no caseworker-facing component.
